title: oxalis acetosella subsp. taimonii
intro: Oxalis acetosella subsp. taimonii, commonly known as the woodland sorrel, is a subspecies of the wood sorrel plant, belonging to the Oxalidaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis acetosella subsp. taimonii include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
